metadata.title: Bad value assignment using list indices when type-promoting

bug_description:
## 🐛 Bug



When type-promoting while assigning values using a list index, e.g. `A[:, [i]] = b`, where `A` and `b` are of different `dtype`, the assignment produces incorrect values.

trigger_conditions.pattern: Implicit Dtype Conversion in Indexed Assignment
trigger_conditions.condition: Assigning tensors with different dtypes through indexed assignment operations, especially advanced indexing, and checking for incorrect value conversion.
trigger_conditions.operation_context: Assigning a tensor of a different dtype to a float64 tensor using an advanced list index, such as A[:, [i]] = b.unsqueeze(-1), where type promotion occurs.

failure_behavior.description: Assigning a tensor of a different dtype to a float64 tensor using an advanced list index, such as A[:, [i]] = b.unsqueeze(-1), where type promotion occurs.
